notes: No modern-fiction members found (Zuul, Dracorex and Ikrandraco are real genera named after fiction; kept). 'T rex' changed to 'T. rex' (the period triggers a checker warning); 'Tyrannosaurus rex' added. 'Kauai oo' left plain: the reference spelling Kaua'i 'ō'ō uses okina characters the game may not handle. Fixed missing UK forms: armor plate/armour plate, hematophage/haematophage; eyrie/aerie swapped so the US main form is aerie. 'Colorado beetle' became 'Colorado potato beetle' (uk 'Colorado beetle'). Kept 'Dall sheep' and 'Stephens Island wren' without apostrophes (those are the standard names). 'animal habitats' and 'animal traits' are not playable themes, so their children were not judged as sub-themes. Extinct animals is separate from prehistoric life because most members (dodo, Javan tiger) are historical, not prehistoric.
